name: agentmd
description: Convert a public web page URL into clean Markdown. Pay-per-call with Solana USDC via HTTP 402 (x402-shaped, direct-to-wallet, zero custody).
notes: Classic MCP servers often speak JSON-RPC over stdio to a local process.
AgentMD is a remote HTTP API. Agents should call it as an HTTP tool (or wrap it with a thin stdio MCP proxy — see mcp/wrapper-sketch.ts comments in README).
Payment is required per call; the tool descriptor advertises price so agents can budget before invoking.

tools.name: scrape_to_markdown
tools.description: Fetch a public http(s) URL and return cleaned Markdown. Requires a prior or concurrent Solana USDC payment to the operator wallet advertised in the 402 challenge.

url.description: Public web page URL (http or https only).

paymentTxSignature.description: Optional Solana transaction signature proving payment. If omitted, the API returns HTTP 402 with payment instructions.

errors.402: Payment required — read PAYMENT-REQUIRED / JSON accepts[].payTo and amount, pay on-chain, retry with proof.

stdioWrapperSketch.purpose: If your agent host only loads stdio MCP servers, run a tiny Node process that exposes scrape_to_markdown and forwards to AgentMD HTTP.
stdioWrapperSketch.warning: Do not put the AgentMD operator seed phrase in the wrapper. Agents pay FROM their own wallet TO the operator payTo address.
